component.name: Disk Sleuth
component.summary: Honest disk usage analysis for Linux

description.p: Disk Sleuth shows where your disk space really went — with honest sizes read straight from the kernel. Logical is what files claim; physical is what the disk actually holds. Hardlinks are charged once, sparse and compressed files report real savings, and unreadable folders are flagged rather than silently skipped.

Features an interactive sunburst you can click to drill into folders, a sortable tree, per-item "freeable now" estimates, and Move to Trash with instant in-memory graph updates. Includes a full CLI (asahidisksleuth scan/top/info/overview/snapshots) with JSON output.
btrfs Freeable lens: reflink clone families are detected via FIEMAP and charged once — see what deleting shared content actually frees.
Initial release: CLI + Kirigami GUI, btrfs snapshot awareness.
